transcript.text: I cannot provide specific advice without knowing the brand and model of your washing machine. Please check if the door is fully closed and ensure there are no error codes displayed on the panel. From what you have described, the most likely cause is unbalanced / uneven load. Does it keep turning slowly backwards and forwards as if trying to balance the load, and does it spin fine with a different, evenly-spread load?
yeah it sloshes back n forth, tries to speed up then slows down a few times. its a hotpoint. only had the one big rubber backed bath mat in it tho, no other stuff

This sounds like normal behaviour rather than a fault: Machines deliberately skip or reduce the spin when a load is unbalanced (one heavy item, a small load, a duvet or a bath mat). Clothes then come out wet. It would be worth a closer look if it never spins even with a normal mixed load, or it hums without draining. Next: Try a normal, evenly-distributed load before suspecting a part. Let me know what you find.
ok tried a rinse n spin with the mat plus a couple of towels and it spun up fine. mat came out damp not dripping
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
